negative_evidence: The model is deliberately simplified/exploratory and is not direct evidence for a measured biological storage implementation.
Behavioral short-term-memory effects are not themselves a generic storage operator; the source-defined store is the overlaid population state.
Hierarchical saturation and mixed-code precision depend on conjunctivity, population size, feature count and receptive-field assumptions.
unresolved_issues: Biological implementation is not directly established; fidelity/scaling conclusions remain assumption-dependent.
preserved_noninferences: external stimulus array does not automatically become internal memory state
behavioral delay does not itself define a storage operator
Bayesian retrieval posterior is not a second persistent store
supplementary mathematics does not create a new coordinator
complexity or fit failure cannot imply A2
